key_developments: DELTA vs prior evening brief: Brent at $97.71 (up $2.96 from $94.75) and WTI at $97.40 (up $2.99 from $94.41) as traders repriced ceasefire optimism back to physical-access realism — Hormuz remains functionally restricted, not normalized, with sub-10% traffic via rerouted Iranian-controlled lanes.

Ceasefire credibility has deteriorated at the margins: Lebanon remains an active combat zone with Israel continuing strikes and evacuation warnings in Beirut's southern suburbs; mediation efforts are under way to bring Lebanon into the arrangement, but compartmentalization is failing.

Islamabad diplomatic track is the key near-term catalyst: Pakistan-hosted US-Iran talks are expected Friday/Saturday, but the scope mismatch between Pakistan's 'ceasefire everywhere' claim and the US/Israeli position that Lebanon is excluded creates an immediate credibility gap to watch.
